visual_direction.base_style_mix: 50% vintage engraving, 30% charcoal sketch, 20% dark gothic oil painting
visual_direction.lighting: extreme chiaroscuro, deep crushed blacks, near-zero ambient fill in interior rooms, one isolated very weak practical light source with narrow falloff; most walls, corners, hallway and doorway remain unreadable, while only a small clue area is faintly revealed
visual_direction.perspective: subtly oppressive asymmetric framing, low or off-axis camera, corridor feels slightly too long, doorframes create visual pressure; retain believable architecture
visual_direction.texture: rough engraved linework, visibly dry charcoal strokes, damp stains, peeling plaster, dust suspended in air, aged scratched surfaces
visual_direction.palette: desaturated cold grey, dirty brown, sickly olive, muted dirty yellow; very limited warm light
visual_direction.negative_space: large deliberate areas of darkness, empty doorway and corridor, no decorative clutter; interior rooms must not be evenly lit
visual_direction.anomaly: only subtle ambiguous irregularities in shadow, framing, or environmental detail; never a visible supernatural entity
visual_direction.continuity: one fictional composite house across all shots: modest two-storey colonial-era tropical house, weathered pale cream plaster, dark green wooden shutters, broad front veranda, rusty black iron gate, dense overgrown tropical garden, narrow central hallway and several wooden doors
